payloadPolicy: No source values, credentials, or SQL text in timing events.
timedBoundaryPlan: three graph INSERT effects as one transaction boundary
full bag/hash comparison and completion receipt
runtime close and final native closing snapshot
unobservedSubstages: journal prepare and phase readback split

uncertaintyRules.afterDispatchWithoutVerifiedCompletion: uncertain-after-dispatch; preserve attempt and prohibit retry
uncertaintyRules.success: completed-verified only with the existing transaction result, exact heads, full bag/hash check, completion receipt, closed runtime and closing snapshot
